fixes_and_failed_evidence: Independent self-to-self inverse-bind probe initially displaced vertices 0.360555m; fixed to zero using actual source Skin.
Unbaked custom skeleton ancestor transforms rejected; imported positive uniform scale/rotation explicitly baked and recorded.

Original FBX exchange produced per-bone 90-degree rest-axis mismatch in UE despite correct positions; native UE GLB control and final native reference exports pass full hierarchy/rest comparison. No universal hardcoded bone-axis repair.
Manny head geometry previously followed native bone axes; fixed to anatomical frames and visually inspected.
161-bone Profile JSON decimal-rounding identity failed; float32-bit numeric canonicalization with type tags now passes real repeated save/reopen.
Final UI compares two actual animation times; independent FBX animation provenance is explicit and SHA-verified.
limits: Quinn remains unverified in #202, outside explicitly agreed first version.
Generated robot has no finger geometry/weights; actual finger acceptance uses licensed external fixtures, never empty target bones.
Original generated holes and nonmanifold topology from #145/#146 remain; this work does not claim production-ready topology.
Exact native UE binding tested with original UE GLB reference; FBX frame conventions can differ and require an actual target-tool check.
Unmapped auxiliary bones preserve local rest; unmatched weighted source auxiliaries collapse to nearest mapped ancestor with diagnostics.
Only explicitly declared planted intervals assert contact; dance/walk measurements are not blanket foot-lock acceptance.
MetaHuman Body and facial animation are separate extensions.
Fit, retarget sampling, serialization and local publication are synchronous; large assets can pause the panel.
main_rebase: Fast-forwarded to 146865d1; incoming changes only Daqian host/editor files, no AINative algorithm changes.
private_evidence_storage: Ignored runtime and Godot cache retain exact references, assets, full pose samples, logs and screenshots; public evidence excludes machine paths and proprietary binary assets.

visual_layout.root_observed: All interop source/reference controls, actions and publication control reachable by vertical scroll.
